_about: Public-domain George Fox (1624-1691), founder of the Society of Friends, for the Word Hoard: the eight-volume Works (1831, its Journal, Great Mistery, Gospel Truth Demonstrated and Epistles), the Journal from the original manuscripts ed. Norman Penney (Cambridge, 1911), the first Collection of Epistles (1698), the bicentenary edition of the Journal (1901) and Rufus Jones's edition of the Autobiography, from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
